plan: Economic theory suggests the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my private value of $28. This eliminates the risk of strategic underbidding (which could cause me to lose a prize worth more than my bid) or overbidding (which could cause me to pay more than the item's worth). Since this is a single round with no repeated interaction, there's no complex game theory to consider beyond bidding my true value.

Economic theory suggests the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my private value of $23. This is because:
1. Bidding less risks losing the item even when winning would be profitable
2. Bidding more risks paying more than the item is worth to me
3. With values drawn independently each round, past rounds are irrelevant
4. The second-price auction mechanism incentivizes truthful bidding
Therefore, I will bid my exact private value.
